name: Carbachol
aliases: CAR405, carbachol chloride, carbamylcholine, choline carbamate chloride, choline chlorine carbamate
summary: Carbachol, also known as carbamylcholine and sold under the brand name Miostat among others, is a cholinomimetic drug that binds and activates acetylcholine receptors. Thus it is classified as a cholinergic agonist. It is primarily used for various ophthalmic purposes, such as for treating glaucoma, or for use during ophthalmic surgery., eye drops).

pharmacology.text: Carbachol, also known as carbamylcholine and sold under the brand name Miostat among others, is a cholinomimetic drug that binds and activates acetylcholine receptors.

uses.text: Carbachol is primarily used in the treatment of glaucoma, but it is also used during ophthalmic surgery. Carbachol eyedrops are used to decrease the pressure in the eye for people with glaucoma. It is sometimes used to constrict the pupils during cataract surgery.

sideEffects.en: As eye drops it can cause blurred vision, eye pain, headache, red eyes and poor vision in dim light. If it is absorbed into the body it can cause sweating, drooling, flushing, stomach cramps, a slow heartbeat and breathing problems, especially in people with asthma.
sideEffects.zh: 作為眼藥水使用時，可能造成視力模糊、眼睛疼痛、頭痛、眼睛發紅與昏暗光線下視力變差。若被身體吸收，可能造成出汗、流口水、潮紅、腹部絞痛、心跳變慢與呼吸問題，氣喘患者尤其明顯。
sideEffects.zhHans: 作为眼药水使用时，可能造成视力模糊、眼睛疼痛、头痛、眼睛发红与昏暗光线下视力变差。若被身体吸收，可能造成出汗、流口水、潮红、腹部绞痛、心跳变慢与呼吸问题，气喘患者尤其明显。

fact.en: Carbachol is a copy of the nerve messenger acetylcholine in which the ester group is swapped for a carbamate. This small change means the enzyme that normally destroys acetylcholine cannot break it down, so its effect lasts much longer.
fact.zh: 卡巴膽鹼是神經傳導物質乙醯膽鹼的仿製品，把其中的酯基換成了胺甲酸酯基。這個小改變讓平常分解乙醯膽鹼的酵素無法分解它，因此作用時間長得多。
fact.zhHans: 卡巴胆碱是神经传导物质乙酰胆碱的仿制品，把其中的酯基换成了胺甲酸酯基。这个小改变让平常分解乙酰胆碱的酵素无法分解它，因此作用时间长得多。
